# main-code-01 run address

Offset 0 of the main-code-01 block runs at 0x60021020; boot0 and boot1 load at reset, the other sections later.

**Category:** layout · **Address:** `0x60021020` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

The block header's load address is not the run address. boot0 (to 0x60030000) and boot1 (to 0x60128800) are loaded at reset; sec1 to sec6 load later, from the startup stages. The block head is copied to 0x60021000 in front of boot0.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): Section bounds and their loading stages are listed in the symbol table; every function address there is a run address on this base. Source: [fenykl firmware symbol table for E-M10 Mark II 1.4](../sources/fenykl.fwapi.md).
- **Physical camera** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): Plugins calling firmware functions at these run addresses work on the maintainer's camera. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).
